findings.evidence: TauCeti/Data/Fin/Basic.lean:311 `theorem finRotate_castSucc {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : finRotate (n + 1) i.castSucc = i.succ`
TauCeti/Data/Fin/Basic.lean:162 `theorem partialProd_last ... : Fin.partialProd f (Fin.last n) = ∏ i, f i`; Mathlib Fin.lean:501 `partialProd_init`.
findings.fix: Delete it; rewrite with `Fin.partialProd_init`, `Fin.partialProd_last`, and `Fin.prod_univ_castSucc` (or `Fin.partialProd_succ` at `last`).
findings.issue: Private `partialProd_last_mul` re-proves through list internals what follows directly from the existing public `Fin.partialProd_last`.

findings.evidence: Basis.lean:93 `change (b.reindex e.symm).repr v.val 0 = _`; Basis.lean:104 and Basis.lean:119 have similar `change` unfoldings; Basic.lean:29 and Basis.lean:23 `@[expose] public section`.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` from both files and prove these from `_apply` lemmas (using `(rfl)` where needed).
findings.issue: Basis proofs use `change` to unfold `fixedEquivTorsionOfBasis`, `fixedBasisEquiv`, and `fixedEquivTorsion` across modules, which only works because both files are `@[expose] public section` (also lines 104 and 119).

findings.fix: Add `@[simp] fixedBasisEquiv_apply` (value `(b.reindex e.symm).repr v.val`, or `fun i ↦ b.repr v.val (e i)`) and `@[simp] fixedBasisEquiv_symm_apply`.
findings.issue: The public equivalence `fixedBasisEquiv` has no `_apply` or `_symm_apply` lemmas, so its consumers can only unfold it.

findings.evidence: Basis.lean:45 needs `(finRotate _).surjective j` before it can rewrite with `linearMap_apply_rotate`.
findings.fix: Add `linearMap_apply : linearMap a v j = a ((finRotate _).symm j) • v ((finRotate _).symm j)` and mark `linearMap_apply_rotate` `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `linearMap` has only the rotated-index evaluation `linearMap_apply_rotate`, not a general `linearMap_apply`, and that lemma is not `@[simp]`.

summary: Both files expose every body via `@[expose]` to cover for missing characterizing lemmas (`fixedBasisEquiv` has no apply lemmas, `linearMap` has no general apply lemma), and both private helpers duplicate existing public TauCeti lemmas.
